article.title: The critical minerals beneath the Trump corollary: The Fortieth Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: The imperial drive to monopolise critical minerals unmasks a renewed strategic architecture: securing military and industrial supply chains enforces peripheral subordination, turning sovereign nations across the Global South into captive reservoirs for Western capital.
